notes.title: News Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259279/b9346603ec9416edc0c82d1dea8780ded0aadb52.jpg[/img]


[b]News Update[/b]

We wanted to give a quick update on what we've been working on but also to say there will be a slight delay with our next update.

[b]New Car[/b]
We're working hard on finishing our new car(can you guess what it is?) - this one is going to be a little bit different from the others in the game so far - more to mod and upgrade!

[b]Drifting[/b]
We've been experimenting with some drift setups - these might not make the next update but should be coming soon.

[b]Core Game Engine[/b]
We've been working on a mobile version of the game - hopefully to be released in the coming weeks. Unfortunately this forced us to take on some unforeseen game engine updates, which has delayed our new content updates. While it means some short term delays, it sets us up better for improvements to the game longer term, including better Steam integration and features.

Apologies for the delay,

BM Studios

notes.title: Update 3 - v1.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259279/bb0f15b32dcc9cdc26c520db90451e011aaceb9e.jpg[/img]

[b]Update 3 - v1.3[/b]

[b]NEW[/b]
- New Car - The Lynx Turbo
- 2 colour schemes 3 alloys types to unlock for the Lynx Turbo
- New Invitational Race
- New Reverse Direction Track - Druids Reach
- New Engine Sounds for all cars!
- New SFX for Gravel and Sandy surfaces
- New Skid SFX

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Buy Cars Screen flow reworked - view previously bought cars and their stats
- Rumble on/off option in menus
- Improved Handling on Lambini and D13
- Sandy surfaces made less slippy
- New default camera position in Garage and Buy Cars menu
- All SFX Volumes re-calibrated

[b]Bugs[/b]
- Rumble staying on - fixed
- Shadows and glows sometimes missing on cars in garage - fixed

notes.title: Regular Update 2 - v1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259279/0a8b8eb438e531dc0f109131d0d331ac22c5a2ba.jpg[/img]

Regular Update 2 - v1.2

NEW
• New Intro and outro cinematics added for each race
• New Rumble/Vibration on controllers added - for collisions, surfaces and skids
• New Collision sounds added for all cars


Improvements
• Current Lap time and Best Lap time replace the Race Time counter
• UI Sounds added to all menu's in the Garage


Bug Fixes
• Time Attack bug - sometimes winning gold when time not achieved - fixed

notes.title: Regular Update 1 - v1.1
notes.notes:
Regular Update 1 - v1.1

NEW
• New Arcade mode option, at start of game and in the options menu.
	- Choose between Arcade and Sim Racing modes
	- Sim Racing mode is suited to regular driving game players
	- Arcade mode is suited to more casual players - cars will generally not slide/spin.
• New descriptions and information for each car, on the Buy Cars Page
• New Restart Race button added to pause menu
• New - Divisions now Re-playable
	- But, you can only be entered in one division at a time.
	- Switching division will lose progress in current division.
• New Unique Rev counters added for each car
• New Starting Lights added before races

Improvements
• Car Handling Balance Changes to Nightbird, Fury and D13 - more grip, less sliding!
• UI re-treated to improve visibility of what's 'selected'
• Trophies added to Divisions you've won
• Stars added to Invitational races and Rival races that you've won
• Rivals Page Artwork re-worked
• Time Attack Page re-worked to explain difficulty and rewards
• Time Attack Times re-calibrated according to difficulty
• Time Attack Rewards increased
• Economy Balance changes - More money for some races and upgrades now less expensive
• Economy Balance - Invitational races have higher rewards and less laps
• Celebration sounds added to podiums
• Back button added to race selection screens
• Racing HUD re-worked with more info
• Character artwork and Dialogue re-formatted and made bigger

Bug Fixes
• Loss of progress on Invitational races fixed
• Leaderboards removed from end of Invitational Races
• Car Audio bugs fixed
• Tuning Menu UX bugs fixed
• Engine noise removed from Podiums

notes.title: GT Racing 1980 - Update 1 coming next week!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259279/ffb8379ce6a075d026d8dc41aff1012945ccd473.jpg[/img]

We wanted to let the community know, that BM Studios will be continuing to support the game and will be adding new features and content over the coming weeks and months.

We want to announce that we are working on our first update, which we plan to release next week.

Update 1 will focus on;
[list]
[*] Important bug fixes
[*] Car handling balancing (based on feedback)
[*] Some new content!
[/list]

We hope you are enjoying GT Racing 1980 so far!

Thanks

BM Studios
